# Astakos AI Agent

> A local-first, LLM-agnostic multi-agent framework orchestrating proactive habits, routines, and a hybrid memory model (ChromaDB + SQLite).

## Overview
- [README.md](/README.md): Architecture, features, and setup instructions

## Architecture
- [Core Framework](/core): LangGraph state machine, Agent definitions, Planner v2, and Event Bus
- [Memory System](/memory): Hybrid ChromaDB semantic store, SQLite conversation history, and working memory JSONs

## Skills and Tools
- [Astakos Skills](/astakos_skills): Modular Python skills (generated dynamically)
- [Project Tools](/tools): Permission-gated local file manipulation
- [Addy Osmani Skills](/vendor/agent-skills): External AI workflows integrated into Astakos

## Configuration
- [Config](/config.py): Environment variables, path definitions, and feature toggles (DO NOT EDIT directly unless asked)
